===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[SpacemiT]] ''Key Stone'' K1 (X60) @1.6GHz :SoC: Octa-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 2.0 TOPS (AI from RlSC-V Core) *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-2-32 @819MHz :32KB SLC (OpenGL ES3.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp60, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp30 *Storage: 16GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF card (max.256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) RAM *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG ports *PCIe: 1x M.2 (Key M), 1x Mini PCIe slot *Wi-Fi: [[Realtek]] RTL8852BS :802.11abgn/ac/ax (2T2R), Bluetooth 4.2 *Network: 2x GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 26-pin connector *Power Source: 12V/3A via barrel or (Type-C) OTG port
